dict.string: Search Jean projects, then run `jean yolo --project` with a prompt.
Search Jean projects, then enter a yolo prompt.

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$PATH"
project_id="$1" project_label="${project_name:-$project_id}"
prompt="$(osascript - "$project_label" <<'APPLESCRIPT' on run argv set projectLabel to item 1 of argv try set dialogResult to display dialog "Prompt for " & projectLabel default answer "" buttons {"Cancel", "Run Yolo"} default button "Run Yolo" cancel button "Cancel" with title "Jean Yolo Project" return text returned of dialogResult on error number -128 return "__JEAN_CANCELLED__" end try end run APPLESCRIPT )"
if [[ "$prompt" == "__JEAN_CANCELLED__" ]]; then exit 0 fi
if [[ -z "${prompt//[[:space:]]/}" ]]; then osascript -e 'display alert "Jean Yolo Project" message "Prompt cannot be empty." as warning' exit 1 fi
output="$(jean yolo --project "$project_id" "$prompt" 2>&1)" cli_status=$?
if [[ $cli_status -ne 0 ]]; then osascript - "$output" <<'APPLESCRIPT' on run argv display alert "Jean Yolo Project failed" message (item 1 of argv) as critical end run APPLESCRIPT exit "$cli_status" fi
osascript - "$project_label" <<'APPLESCRIPT' on run argv display notification "Queued yolo session for " & (item 1 of argv) with title "Jean" end run APPLESCRIPT
Trigger with `yp`, type to search Jean projects, select one, then enter a prompt. The workflow runs `jean yolo --project <project-id> <prompt>`.
